name: Rubinstein Minimum-Degree Class
definition: For each $d\ge10$, this is the class $V_d$ on $d+2$ coordinates from Corollary 44 of Rubinstein--Bartlett--Rubinstein. Its bitwise complement is the union of three sets: $S_1$ has four free coordinates, then the fixed word $00110011$, then $d-10$ zero coordinates; $S_2$ has fixed $0011$, then four free coordinates, then fixed $1100$, then $d-10$ zero coordinates; $S_3$ has fixed $11001100$, then $d-6$ free coordinates.
